title: S8 Tower-to-Mobile Handoff
description: S8 v1.0.0 contract for transferring lift data from Tower Planner to Mobile Planner. Planning aid, not a certified lift plan. Tower Planner supplies tower/component/location context only and must not include Mobile Planner PASS/FAIL assessments. Mobile Planner converts the absolute site coordinates to its own crane-relative frame and performs its own M2 assessment. A null rigging_mass_t is structurally valid and means unknown, never zero: Mobile Planner must treat it as INCOMPLETE before invoking calculateLiftCheck and must not pass null into M2. INCOMPLETE is a Mobile runtime/interface outcome, not an M2 result; M2 outcomes remain PASS, FAIL and UNSUPPORTED. JSON Schema does not require a non-empty issues array solely because rigging_mass_t is null; generating the appropriate missing-information issue is a Tower producer/runtime responsibility.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the handoff was created.

units.description: Fixed S8 units: metres, tonnes and degrees. Mass values in this payload are tonnes; keep them distinct from any internal millimetre model values.

id.description: Identity of the project-declared absolute site frame.

description.description: Project-specific origin declaration, e.g. the south-west corner of the site. It must not be treated as a universal origin.

coordinate_frame.description: Absolute site frame in metres: +X east, +Y north, +Z up. All pick_xy and set_xy values use this frame, not a crane-relative frame. Tower crane slew is a Tower Planner property and must never be interpreted as the Mobile Planner boom angle.

jib_length_m.description: Tower crane jib length in metres.

configuration.description: Tower Planner configuration context. Additional tower configuration fields may be supplied; this is not a Mobile crane configuration.

mast_position.description: Absolute site-frame tower mast position in metres. Tower context only; it is not the selected Mobile crane position.

tower_crane.description: Tower crane identity and configuration context. Tower Planner must not provide Mobile crane configuration, capacity, utilisation or PASS/FAIL results.

issues.description: Warnings or missing-information notices. Missing or insufficient information must be reported here rather than silently replaced with a default. A null rigging_mass_t is structurally valid; this schema does not require a non-empty issues array solely because rigging_mass_t is null, so the Tower producer/runtime is responsible for generating the appropriate issue. The Mobile consumer must still treat a null rigging mass as INCOMPLETE before invoking calculateLiftCheck, and calculateLiftCheck must never receive null rigging mass. The same producer/runtime issue-reporting expectation applies when component.mass_t is null with mass_source.kind 'not_stated'.

x_m.description: Absolute east coordinate in metres (+X east).

y_m.description: Absolute north coordinate in metres (+Y north).

siteCoordinate.description: Absolute project-declared site coordinate in metres. S8 must not send pre-converted Mobile crane-relative points.

kind.description: Source classification. 'not_stated' is only valid when component.mass_t is null; any numeric mass needs a traceable source other than 'not_stated'. 'not_stated' declares the absence of a mass value; it does not itself create an issue record, and this schema does not require a non-empty issues array for the null case.

page.description: Page reference within the source document.

section.description: Section reference within the source document.

massSource.description: Traceable provenance for component mass. A numeric mass requires a document and a page or section reference. For a null mass, mass_source is still required and kind must be 'not_stated'; document, page and section are not required for that null declaration. The schema does not require an issues entry solely because the mass is null; the Tower producer/runtime is responsible for reporting the missing information.

mass_t.description: Component payload mass only, in tonnes. Excludes rigging mass. Numeric values must be positive; use null when the mass is not stated, never zero as a placeholder. A null value is only permitted with mass_source.kind 'not_stated'. A null mass is structurally valid and must never be interpreted as zero. This schema does not require a non-empty issues array solely because mass_t is null; the Tower producer/runtime is responsible for generating the appropriate missing-information issue. Consumers must not substitute a default or proceed with a definitive assessment until the payload mass is provided or confirmed.

mass_basis.description: Confirms that mass_t is component payload only and excludes rigging mass.

component.description: Component payload and its traceable mass provenance. mass_t never includes rigging mass. A null mass_t is valid only with mass_source.kind 'not_stated'; it is not zero and is not made structurally invalid by an empty issues array.

rigging_mass_t.description: Rigging mass in tonnes, separate from component.mass_t. A non-negative number or null is structurally valid; null means unknown or unconfirmed, never zero. A null value does not by itself make the payload structurally invalid, and this schema does not require a non-empty issues array solely because rigging_mass_t is null; generating the appropriate missing-information issue is a Tower producer/runtime responsibility. Mobile Planner must treat null as INCOMPLETE at the runtime/interface level before calculateLiftCheck is invoked. calculateLiftCheck must never receive a null rigging mass. INCOMPLETE is a runtime/interface assessment state, not a new M2 calculation outcome; M2 outcomes remain PASS, FAIL and UNSUPPORTED. Mobile must obtain or confirm a numeric rigging mass and include it in the total suspended load before any definitive assessment; once all required numeric inputs are present, it may invoke the existing M2 calculateLiftCheck.

coordinate_source.description: Provenance of the absolute pick/set coordinates.

lift.description: One lift. Pick and set points are absolute site coordinates; Mobile Planner converts them to its own crane-relative frame before M2 assessment. rigging_mass_t is required but may be null; a null value is structurally valid and is handled as INCOMPLETE by Mobile runtime before calculateLiftCheck.

severity.description: Warning or informational missing-information notice. Structural violations are schema errors, not issue records.

code.description: Stable machine-readable issue code, e.g. RIGGING_MASS_NOT_PROVIDED.

message.description: Human-readable description of the warning or missing information.

field.description: Optional reference to the affected field path, e.g. lifts[0].rigging_mass_t.

issue.description: Warning or missing-information notice. Issues do not represent a Mobile Planner PASS/FAIL assessment.
